newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers steady to lower.

text.p: Basis offers in U.S. cash soybean meal markets were mostly steady to slightly lower Tuesday as brokers focused on Chicago Board of Trade futures reaction to a higher-than-expected soybean production estimate from the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
"The board is going to lead us one way or the other," said one Minnesota-based broker.
USDA pegged the soybean crop at 2.403 billion bushels, which would be the second largest crop on record,
However, the cash soymeal market remained firmly underpinned by tight near-term supplies, brokers said.
The drop in futures was expected to stir end-user buying Tuesday, but most brokers reported quiet dealings early.
"I see people just still just sitting on their hands," one river broker said. "I don't think this crop number was unexpected."
